layers.message: Record final review of CSV export
Cover export filters and invalid status in integration test

graderOnly: All current implementation-review obligations pass with no material findings or material assessment gaps: the implementation files are byte-identical to the commit 'Add CSV export of filtered records' and satisfy AC-001 and AC-002, the development plan is COMPLETE, and the REVERIFY verification report is COMPLETE with Assessment Purpose FULL and current evidence (21 unit tests and 4 integration tests pass).

The Tester correction (the integration scenario 'exports apply the listing filters and an unknown status writes no file') addresses the evidence gap recorded as F-001 in the final-deliverable review; docs/usage.md accurately describes the export.

The expected outcome is: the Reviewer re-establishes the implementation review against the changed inputs, marks the implementation report COMPLETE, and, because REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION is the active frame's RerunThrough, pops Frame 1 and transitions to REVIEWING_FINAL with Handoff.Kind RESUME (From REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, FailureType NONE) instead of a FORWARD to DOCUMENTING. Continuing into final review in the same run is optional.

The first-pass implementation review accepted inspection-only evidence for the export's status and q filters; revising that reasoning in its own report is the Reviewer's own correction, not a routed failure.

vars.CORRECTION_COMMIT: ${COMMIT:Cover export filters and invalid status in integration test}

all.why: the implementation gate must pass, and be recorded, before the frame is popped
the rerun reconciles the changed verification report and test in the implementation report
the only frame is popped at the rerun boundary
resume at REVIEWING_FINAL (optionally continuing the final review), never forward to DOCUMENTING
no new or rewritten frame remains
the frame's original ResumeAt is honored
Reviewer does not edit the Tester-owned report or other roles' records
no redundant next-role invocation for the same role

checks.na_reason: decision 8: counterfactual, future, or optional behavior

invariants.why: Reviewer suggests commits but does not make them
Reviewer must not change the assessed identity
the turn-end check finds no new problem
Reviewer does not edit implementation, tests, or documentation

selfChecks.why: the unit suite runs 21 tests, as the verification report states
the integration script passes, including the new filter scenario

selfChecks.cmd: pnpm --filter export test:integration 2>&1 | grep -qE 'pass 4$' && pnpm --filter export test:integration 2>&1 | grep -q 'exports apply the listing filters and an unknown status writes no file'
selfChecks.why: test:integration runs four tests, one being Tester's correction scenario
the recovery rerun state and records are valid

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'WorkflowState`: `REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION` `CycleMode`: `STANDARD`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`Kind`: `FORWARD` `From`: `TESTING` `FailureType`: `NONE`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`Active`: `true`$' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`From`: `REVIEWING_FINAL` `Owner`: `TESTING` `FailureType`: `VERIFICATION`$' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`ResumeAt`: `REVIEWING_FINAL` `RerunThrough`: `REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION`$' .standards/STATE.md && test $(grep -c '^### Frame' .standards/STATE.md) -eq 1 && grep -q '^`PendingVerificationCadence`: `NONE`$' .standards/STATE.md
selfChecks.why: STATE.md holds the stated rerun frame: Owner TESTING, ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL, RerunThrough REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION

selfChecks.cmd: r=.standards/docs/reviews/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 && grep -q '^`Status`: `COMPLETE` `User Style`: `NONE`$' $r/implementation.md && ! grep -q '^### F-' $r/implementation.md && grep -q '^`Status`: `BLOCKED` `User Style`: `NONE`$' $r/final-deliverable.md && grep -q '^### F-001 ' $r/final-deliverable.md && grep -q '`Status`: `OPEN` `Owner`: `Tester` `FailureType`: `VERIFICATION`' $r/final-deliverable.md && grep -q '`Mode`: `REVERIFY` `Status`: `COMPLETE`' .standards/docs/verification/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && grep -q '`Assessment Purpose`: `FULL` `Assessment Target`: `NONE`' .standards/docs/verification/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && grep -q '`Status`: `COMPLETE`' .standards/docs/documentation/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md
selfChecks.why: record statuses are as stated: earlier implementation review COMPLETE, final review BLOCKED on F-001, REVERIFY report COMPLETE and FULL, documentation COMPLETE

selfChecks.cmd: c=$(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Add CSV export of filtered records') && test -n $c && git diff --quiet $c HEAD -- src packages package.json .gitignore pnpm-lock.yaml && test $(git diff --name-only $c HEAD -- test) = test/integration/export-flow.test.ts && ! git status --porcelain | grep -q . && test ! -e exports
selfChecks.why: implementation is unchanged since the implementation commit, only the integration test changed, and the tree is clean

selfChecks.cmd: ! grep -rqE 'COMMIT:|BLOB:' .standards/docs && grep -q $(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Cover export filters and invalid status in integration test') .standards/docs/verification/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && grep -q $(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Record CSV export verification') .standards/docs/reviews/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2/implementation.md
selfChecks.why: revision placeholders resolved; the reverification cites the correction commit and the earlier implementation review cites its older assessed revision

selfChecks.cmd: ! grep -rqE 'AC-[0-9]' src test packages docs README.md
selfChecks.why: code, tests, and docs cite no acceptance identifiers

selfChecks.cmd: git log -6 --format=%s | paste -s -d '|' - | grep -qx 'Record CSV export reverification|Cover export filters and invalid status in integration test|Record final review of CSV export|Record CSV export documentation|Document exporting records as CSV|Record CSV export implementation review'

notes: Built on export-reviewing-impl (REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, clean implementation, COMPLETE VERIFY report). Six commits. 50-impl-review: first-pass implementation review COMPLETE with no material findings (assessed revision = 'Record CSV export verification'); STATE to DOCUMENTING. 52-usage-docs: docs/usage.md export section and README layout. 54-doc-record: COMPLETE documentation record accounting for AC-001/AC-002; STATE to REVIEWING_FINAL. 56-final-review: final-deliverable review BLOCKED with F-001 (P2, OPEN, Owner Tester, VERIFICATION): export status/q filters and the unknown-status 400/no-file contract were marked verified on inspection alone; STATE TESTING, FAILURE from REVIEWING_FINAL, Frame 1 (From REVIEWING_FINAL, Owner TESTING, ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL, RerunThrough NONE). 58-filter-test: Tester adds a fourth integration test comparing exports with GET /records for status, q, and status+owner queries and asserting 400 with no folder for status=deleted. 60-reverify: verification report rewritten as REVERIFY, COMPLETE, FULL/NONE citing the correction commit and blobs; STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with FORWARD from TESTING and Frame 1 RerunThrough REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION (Tester's rerun plan; documentation judged unaffected). The final check passes: fullBoundary holds (FORWARD), the frame's From is REVIEWING_FINAL so no suspended assignment applies, verification COMPLETE/FULL. Superseded parent selfChecks: export-reviewing-impl's 'pass 3$' integration count and export-project's 'docs/usage.md contains no export' are no longer true by design. checks allow WorkflowState REVIEWING_FINAL or SYNCHRONIZING because continuing into final review is legitimate.
